claims: Decode runs at a median of 16.4 tokens/s with a 16,384-token KV capacity; the first token of a 32-token prompt arrives after a median of 0.62-0.64 s once the model is loaded.
Decode speed depends on the KV capacity compiled into the package, not on the position: every step binds the full caches.
After the device reaches the fair thermal state the engine paces decode to 110 ms per token (about 9 tokens/s).

procedure.prompt: 32 tokens, fixed text, no system prompt
procedure.speed: per run, 1000 / median inter-token interval over tokens 33..512; reported value = median of the 5 runs
procedure.firstToken: request start to the first sampled token, after warmup (model loaded)
procedure.thermal: each run starts in the nominal state, confirmed within 10 s
procedure.exactTokens: stop tokens suppressed so that every run generates exactly 512 tokens
procedure.samplerSeed: not fixed (system random generator); the speed measurement does not depend on the sampled text

pacedRunNote: in each set of five runs one run entered the fair state during generation and was paced (median interval about 110 ms, 9.0 tokens/s); the median of five is unaffected

capacity.note: same code, Debug build, plugged in, cold start, 512 generated tokens; source is a development note, not a recorded verdict

prefill.note: continuation turns of the sustained run (sustained.json) whose KV could not be reused re-prefilled the whole conversation

derivedTokensPerSecond.formula: promptTokens / first-token seconds (includes the final full step and sampling)

prefill.plan: prompt tokens except the last run through chunks 0-3 only, 16 per call (prefill_16), remainder one per call; the last token runs step_1 through all 8 chunks

kvRestore.note: Debug build, capacity 16384, outputs preallocated: a 13.7K-token conversation released, the engine reloaded in the same process and the host KV read back from disk

load.note: Debug build, single-capacity 16384 package, first launch compiles all 8 chunks for the Neural Engine; later launches load from the compile cache

published.note: external figures for comparison; different device generation, runtime, compute unit, quantization and context capacity; not a like-for-like comparison and not reproduced here

rows.conditions: 1024 prefill tokens, 256 decode tokens, context 2048; time to first token excludes load; caches enabled and initialized
rows.memoryMetric: peak CPU memory; phys_footprint on iOS
rows.modelFile: 3.66 GB (2.24 GB decoder weights, 0.67 GB embedding parameters, memory-mapped)

rows.notes: multimodal Gemma 4 E4B build: 5 INT8 chunks of 8 layers, FP16 head, memory-mapped embeddings, context 2048, as stated by the project
